paragraphs.text: The Thunder Islands is a group of islands in the Jamuraan Sea north of Shimia , part of the supercontinent of Jamuraa , on the plane of Dominaria .

The Thunder Islands are home to savage berserkers and are said to be beautiful and wild. They are located in the Jamuraan Sea , a treacherous stretch of ocean that is difficult to navigate for all its shoals, reefs, sand bars, and islets.

Lorens , a Thunder Islands native, was taken into slavery by Emperor Johan of Tirras and set to work building the city's floating airships as part of Johan's War . After the slave rebellion, Lorens joined the Robaran Mercenaries and even became one of Adira Strongheart 's Circle of Seven. He fought bravely and powerfully, often mentioning his homeland and being homesick. Unfortunately, he was killed in the Battle of Efrava , and never got to see his island home again.
